set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- API supports weights, cost, epsilon, scaling/log method, starts, tolerances, and limits.
- Results use the common class.
- Scaling/log agree normally; log stays finite in underflow stress cases.
- Marginal residual or non-convergence status is reported.
- Deterministic POT differentials and representative benchmarks pass.
set.title: Expose balanced entropic OT with scaling and log Sinkhorn
